relink.descDoc: This layout references files that do not exist in the current figure library (common when opening a project package on another machine). Pick a replacement for each; panels you leave alone stay missing and will be flagged by the pre-export check.
relink.descPaste: Panels on the clipboard reference files that do not exist in the current figure library. Pick a replacement for each, or skip that panel.
relink.footnote: Relinking resets the figure edits to the new asset's size and script (overrides are bound to elements of the original script, so they do not transfer reliably). Position, size, stacking order and grouping are kept.
